newsitem.title: TAIWAN: ASE third quarter net profit up 3.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: ASE third quarter net profit up 3.3 pct.

text.p: ASE Test Ltd, the first Taiwanese firm directly listed in the Nasdaq National Market, said on Tuesday its third quarter net profit climbed 3.3 percent to T$70.1 million (US$2.6 million) from the same period a year ago.
ASE Test, an integrated-circuit testing firm, is 79.6 percent owned by Taiwan's integrated-circuit packaging firm Advanced Semiconductor Engineering Inc.
ASE Test's third quarter sales increased 18.7 percent to T$289.9 million from the third quarter of 1995.

Net profit per share in the third quarter declined 10.8 percent to T$4.85 (US$0.18) from T$5.44 ($0.20) due to higher number of shares outstanding after ASE Test's initial public offer in June 1996, it said in a statement.

ASE Test said its third quarter net revenue declined 10.4 percent from the second quarter mainly due to industry-wide inventory correction, which resulted in reduced demand for testing services among ASE Test's major customers.

ASE Test said it expected the inventory correction to come to an end soon. Logic integrated-circuit testing remained the firm's business, it said. ASE Test held its initial public offering on June 6, 1996 on Nasdaq.
